text:
mina: FYI rolled SqueezePacker v2.2 to canary overnight. Quick headline: p95 down ~14%, p99 down ~9% on mixed-chat traffic, overall token cost -7.3% on the canary hosts.

diego: nice! what changed in this iteration?

mina: three concise updates: 1) tighter microbatch packing when requests have similar remaining token budgets; 2) early-kv-prefetch for predicted continuations (heuristic-based); 3) lightweight batch coalescer that runs before GPU submission to merge small batches created by racey enqueues.

harper: any latency regressions for single-turn low-latency routes?

mina: measured p50 stable, single-digit ms increase (~1-4ms) for <64 token requests under very light load. But p95 improves across the board because we avoid oscillating tiny batches.

sre-bot: ci-bot reports: SqueezePacker v2.2 -> canary cluster (canary-3) DEPLOYED at 2024-10-05T06:45:12Z

diego: config snippet for ops?

mina: paste: 

```
packer_mode: squeeze_v2
batch_similarity_window_ms: 10
prefetch_predictor: enabled
coalesce_before_gpu_ms: 3
max_pack_tokens: 2048
```

harper: were there any OOMs or increased GPU stalls?

mina: we saw two short-lived stalls during a synthetic flood. Adjusted pacer backpressure thresholds and added an adaptive yield; no further stalls. Increased canary pod mem by 4% as a precaution.

diego: bench dashboards?

mina: dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/squeeze-packer/canary-3. Key panels: pack_size_by_route, prefetch_hit_rate, gpu_stall_events, cost_delta. Snapshot: median pack_size +1.6x, prefetch hit rate 28%, token cost -7.3%.

harper: rollout plan and rollback gates?

mina: rollout plan: 10% eu-west -> 25% -> 60% over 5 days. Rollback triggers: p99 regression >6% OR error rate >0.5% sustained over 15m. Also halt if gpu_stall_events spike >3x baseline.

diego: can we log pack_size and prefetch_hit to trace spans?

mina: PR #4301 adds span fields: pack_size, prefetch_hit, coalesce_flag. Landing now.

sre-bot: synthetic job created: perf-synth/squeeze-edge (covers long sequences, short bursts, and streaming toggles) runs every 30m

harper: product question: should we enable this by default for new Hosted tenants?

mina: recommend opt-in for now. We'll collect 7 days of canary + regional flips before recommending as default. For Private we keep disabled unless requested.

diego: can you add a short blurb for #announcements and release notes?

mina: will post: "SqueezePacker v2.2 (canary): tighter microbatch packing and predictive prefetch reduce p95 latency and token cost for mixed-chat workloads. Opt-in in Console under 'Adaptive packers'."

harper: awesome, thanks team :partyparrot:

mina: I'll post a canary wrap after the 72h eu-west run with final numbers and any followups.
